title: Expectation of a constant shift
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, and let $c\in\mathbb R$. Then $\mathbb E_\pi(f+c)=\mathbb E_\pi f+c$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
